articles.title_en: Russian missile strike on apartment building in Pryluky, northern Ukraine, kills 22 people, including five children
articles.lead_en: The search and rescue operation has ended at the site of a strike on a five-story apartment building in Pryluky, in Ukraine’s Chernihiv region. A Russian Kh-101 missile partially destroyed the building on the morning of October 7, when many residents were still asleep.

articles.title_en: Ukraine hit a data center operated by the Russian tech giant Yandex. How vulnerable is Russia’s internet to further drone attacks?
